status_definitions.E2E_VERIFIED_LOCAL: The end-user flow is connected and verified only in the isolated local environment.
status_definitions.UI_AVAILABLE_LOCAL: A local user interface exists, but production identity, traffic, or external services are not connected.
status_definitions.AUTO_VERIFIED_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Automated checks pass, but the required human review is not complete.
status_definitions.RULE_ENGINE_ONLY: Deterministic rules exist; this is not a generative or reasoning AI capability.
status_definitions.CODED_NOT_AUTOMATED: A calculation function exists, but no scheduler, queue, worker, or delivery automation is connected.
status_definitions.CODED_NO_END_USER_UI: Domain code exists without an end-user surface or completed journey.
status_definitions.RUNTIME_WIRED_LOCAL_PARTIAL: A subset of the capability runs locally; required roles or production integrations are missing.
status_definitions.CODED_LOCAL_CONTROLS: Local policy controls exist, but managed production enforcement is not connected.
status_definitions.RUNTIME_VERIFIED_LOCAL: The local runtime behavior is connected and verified.
status_definitions.RUNTIME_WIRED_LOCAL_ONLY: The capability emits or serves local runtime data without production operations.
status_definitions.APPROVED_NOT_RUNTIME_WIRED: The asset or behavior was manually approved, but it is not yet connected across the product runtime.
